entities.summary:
Georgios Tzelilis is a Greek weightlifter. He competed in the men's featherweight event at the 1996 Summer Olympics and he was fourth. He tied with Xiao Jiangang with 322,5 kilos in total, but he was placed fourth because he was heavier than him
 Tzelilis missed 2000 Summer Olympics and 2004 Summer Olympics due to injuries. He was married with Mirela Manjani from 1997 to 2002.
